subject: SIG change notice: impact assessment and proposed re-answer plan
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice.j@nexuspay.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: NexusPay Security Team <security@nexuspay.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG v18 change notice and evidence request

Hi Mina,

We received a notice this morning that the SIG questionnaire has moved to v18 and several control statements have been reworded (notably sections 5.2, 7.1.3, and 9.4). For NexusPay's procurement review we need:

- A short impact assessment describing which of your prior answers (SIG v15/v16) will materially change.
- Re-answered items (re-answers) for any affected controls.
- Supporting evidence for the re-answered controls (diagrams, policy excerpts, SOC2 scope blurb).

Can you confirm whether Redwood will: 1) provide a redline of your delta answers, 2) supply attachments (SOC2 report, network diagrams), and 3) a proposed timeline for delivery? Our due date for procurement sign-off is Apr 12.

Attachment: revised_SIG_v18.pdf (new questionnaire)

Thanks,
Alice

--
Alice Johnson
Security Manager, NexusPay
alice.j@nexuspay.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG v18 change notice and evidence request

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. We will do a scoped impact assessment and provide re-answers for the controls that changed meaningfully.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Triage: identify controls with substantive wording changes vs. cosmetic wording. (owner: Rishi)
- Evidence mapping: surface SOC2 artifact excerpts and diagrams for re-answered sections. (owner: Karthik)
- Redline: produce a redlined answer set and a short delta summary for you. (owner: Mina/Stef)
- Delivery target: initial triage + delta summary by Apr 5, draft re-answers & attachments by Apr 9.

Do you need a full CSV of every question, or will a redlined subset + supporting evidence for affected controls suffice for procurement?

Attachment: none

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Quick triage notes after a pass through revised_SIG_v18.pdf:
- Sections 5.2 and 7.1.3 appear to tighten language around key management and ephemeral key handling — likely to lead to changed answers.
- Section 9.4 introduces a new question about cross-region log replication retention that we did not have in v16.

Evidence we can attach immediately:
- SOC2-report-2023.pdf (attestation + description of in-scope services)
- kms-diagram.png (KMS topology and zone isolation)
- backups_policy_snippet.txt (policy excerpt) — I will pull this and put in the Drive folder.

Estimate: triage (complete) by EOD Apr 3, redlined answers + draft evidence by Apr 8. If NexusPay needs everything earlier we can compress but will require an extra reviewer on Apr 7.

Rishi
